items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: I didn't know him until later on... I worked for Capone's brother, Ralph.

ctx.x: He didn't come around to him. He might have.

You didn't see him? No, I didn't know him until later on, you know. Yeah, it was maybe a year or so before he was killed, assassinated. But he could have, and I worked for it. I worked for Capone's brother, Ralph. Yeah, the syndicate had the grand tier, so the Hood Heinz bands. A fellow by the name of Fox, Ed Fox, was the front and the manager I'd say. And so I worked for him. And then his brother had a place called Cotton Club. The late Walter Barnes played there sometimes too. He's a fellow that brought up in…
Yeah, where was he from, anyhow, really?
